dedupe_keys.name: community aware wireless sensor network topology control simulation logs

description: This dataset contains simulation outputs for community-aware topology control in wireless sensor networks. The Universidad de Cuenca research group publishes trace-derived tables and logs from ns-3 experiments using the Hybrid Wireless Mesh Protocol and a map-based mobility model. Documented outputs include routed and forwarded messages, packet counts, delay, node roles and simulation timestamps. The associated paper describes six mobility scenarios. Coverage is controlled simulated networks and parameter settings, with no established real-world geographic sample or observational calendar. Files are publicly available in experimental configuration folders, including DAT logs. The README permits academic and research use with citation and acknowledgement; it does not state a general open licence or a charge. A limitation is that fields described as transmission and reception energy are expressed in bytes. They are traffic proxies and should not be treated as measured joules without an explicit conversion model. Exact sampling intervals and full column definitions require further checking. Simulation uses include comparing routing overhead, delay and topology-control behaviour. It relates directly to platform-ns-3. No logs were downloaded and the paper’s reported performance improvements were not reproduced.
licence: Custom academic and research use only; citation and acknowledgement required
